anomalies.description: A red SUV collides with a white-and-red ambulance that is entering the intersection from the right; the impact occurs around frame f5 (10.5s), causing the ambulance to rotate and come to rest on the sidewalk by f6 (11.0s).; A dark SUV is seen making a sharp left turn at an intersection and appears to strike a person or object on the sidewalk, causing a visible impact and immediate stop; a helmet or object lies on the road afterward.

A silver sedan abruptly enters the intersection from the left, cutting across the path of the dashcam vehicle and nearly colliding; the sedan swerves sharply to avoid impact, with visible tire skid marks and body deformation suggesting contact or near-contact.
A blue tractor on the right side of the road loses control, veers sharply left, and collides with a dark sedan directly ahead, causing the tractor to flip onto its side.

A black SUV on the right side of the road loses control, swerves sharply leftward, and collides with a stationary or slow-moving object (possibly a parked vehicle or roadside structure) near the curb, causing visible dust/debris and abrupt change in vehicle orientation.
